name: getMyCommands
description: Use this method to get the current list of the bot's commands for the given scope and user language. Returns an Array of [BotCommand](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#botcommand) objects. If commands aren't set, an empty list is returned.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: A JSON-serialized object, describing scope of users. Defaults to [BotCommandScopeDefault](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#botcommandscopedefault).

parameters.name: language_code
parameters.description: A two-letter ISO 639-1 language code or an empty string
